	local inst = root:FindFirstChild(name)
	if not inst then return nil end
	local ok, res = pcall(require, inst)
	if not ok then
		say("require %s failed: %s", name, tostring(res))
		return nil
	end
	return res
end

local function premiumIds()
	local ids = {}
	local Tools = M.Tools
	if Tools and Tools.LIST then
		for _, item in pairs(Tools.LIST) do
			if type(item) == "table" and item.premium and item.id then
				table.insert(ids, item.id)
			end
		end
	end
	return ids
end

local function realOwns(id)
	local P = M.Passes
	if not P then return false end
	if RunService:IsStudio() and P.studioUnlock then
		return true
	end
	local v1 = P.ALIAS[id] or id
	local cat = P.CAT[v1]
	if P.owned[v1] or P.packOwned.bundle or P.freeItems[v1] then
		return true
	end
	if not cat then
		return false
	end
	if P.trialOn then
		return true
	end
	if P.tryItem == v1 and os.clock() < (P.tryEnd or 0) then
		return true
	end
	if cat == "tools" or cat == "powers" then
		return P.packOwned[cat] == true
	end
	return false
end

local function realOwnsSkin(id, sub)
	local P = M.Passes
	return P.freeSkins[tostring(id) .. "/" .. tostring(sub)] == true
end

local function realIsVip()
	local P = M.Passes
	return P.packOwned.vip == true
end

local function realOwnsPack(pack)
	local P = M.Passes
	if pack == "vip" then
		return P.packOwned.vip == true
	end
	if P.packOwned[pack] == true then
		return true
	end
	return P.packOwned.bundle == true
end

local function truePackFlags()
	local flags = {}
	local mms = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
	local uid = Players.LocalPlayer and Players.LocalPlayer.UserId
	local ids = (M.Passes and M.Passes.PACK_IDS) or {}
	for name, id in pairs(ids) do
		if type(id) == "number" and id ~= 0 and uid then
			local ok, has = pcall(function()
				return mms:UserOwnsGamePassAsync(uid, id)
			end)
			if ok and has == true then
				flags[name] = true
			end
		end
	end
	return flags
end

local function serverTrialLeft()
	local Products = M.Products
	if Products and Products.state then
		return tonumber(Products.state.trialLeft) or 0
	end
	return 0
end

local function setPremium(on)
	local P = M.Passes
	if not P then
		say("Passes module missing")
		return false
	end

	if on then
		if not orig.pack then
			orig.pack = {}
			for k, v in pairs(P.packOwned or {}) do
				orig.pack[k] = v
			end
			orig.trialOn = P.trialOn
			orig.studioUnlock = P.studioUnlock
		end

		P.owns = function(_)
			return true
		end
		P.ownsSkin = function()
			return true
		end
		P.isVip = function()
			return true
		end
		P.ownsPack = function(_)
			return true
		end
		P.trialOn = true
		P.studioUnlock = true
		P.packOwned = P.packOwned or {}
		P.packOwned.bundle = true
		P.packOwned.tools = true
		P.packOwned.powers = true
		P.packOwned.vip = true
		P.owned = P.owned or {}
		P.freeItems = P.freeItems or {}

		local ids = premiumIds()
		for _, id in ipairs(ids) do
			P.owned[id] = true
			P.freeItems[id] = true
			P.CAT = P.CAT or {}
			P.CAT[id] = P.CAT[id] or "tools"
		end
		state.ids = #ids
		state.premium = true
		say("premium ON: %d ids", #ids)
	else
		P.owns = realOwns
		P.ownsSkin = realOwnsSkin
		P.isVip = realIsVip
		P.ownsPack = realOwnsPack
		P.trialOn = serverTrialLeft() > 0
		P.studioUnlock = orig.studioUnlock
		local real = truePackFlags()
		for k in pairs(P.packOwned or {}) do
			P.packOwned[k] = nil
		end
		for k, v in pairs(real) do
			P.packOwned[k] = v
		end
		for _, id in ipairs(premiumIds()) do
			if P.owned then P.owned[id] = nil end
			if P.freeItems then P.freeItems[id] = nil end
		end
		state.premium = false
		say("premium OFF")
	end

	refreshButton()
	return true
end

local function viewport()
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	return cam and cam.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1280, 720)
end

local function moveTo(center)
	if not btn then return end
	local v = viewport()
	local ins = GuiService:GetGuiInset()
	local half = btn.AbsoluteSize * 0.5
	local cx = math.clamp(center.X, half.X, math.max(half.X, v.X - half.X))
	local cy = math.clamp(center.Y, half.Y, math.max(half.Y, v.Y - half.Y))
	btn.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(cx + ins.X, cy + ins.Y)
	state.pos = Vector2.new(cx, cy)
end

local function placeButton()
	if not btn then return end
	local v = viewport()
	local compact = v.X < 900 or v.Y < 620
	local w = compact and 104 or 118
	local h = compact and 26 or 30
	btn.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	btn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, h)
	btn.TextSize = compact and 12 or 13
	if state.pos then
		moveTo(state.pos)
	else
		btn.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, GuiService:GetGuiInset().Y)
	end
end

refreshButton = function()
	if not btn then return end
	btn.Text = state.premium and ("PREMIUM ON " .. state.ids) or "PREMIUM OFF"
	btn.BackgroundColor3 = state.premium and Color3.fromRGB(38, 120, 74) or Color3.fromRGB(74, 44, 48)
end

local function destroyButton()
	for _, c in ipairs(conns) do
		pcall(function()
			c:Disconnect()
		end)
	end
	table.clear(conns)
	if btn then
		pcall(function()
			btn:Destroy()
		end)
	end
	btn = nil
end

local function buildButton()
	destroyButton()

	local pg = Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
	for _, c in pg:GetChildren() do
		if c:IsA("ScreenGui") and c.Name == "TTOPremium" then
			pcall(function()
				c:Destroy()
			end)
		end
	end

	local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	gui.Name = "TTOPremium"
	gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
	gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
	gui.DisplayOrder = 999
	gui.Parent = pg

	btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	btn.Name = "PremiumToggle"
	btn.Text = ""
	btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 244, 250)
	btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
	btn.AutoButtonColor = true
	btn.Parent = gui

	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
	corner.Parent = btn

	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(90, 98, 120)
	stroke.Thickness = 1
	stroke.Parent = btn

	local drag = {
		active = false,
		moved = false,
		startPos = Vector2.zero,
		startCenter = Vector2.zero,
	}

	local function isPointer(t)
		return t == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or t == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
	end

	btn.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if not isPointer(input.UserInputType) then return end
		drag.active = true
		drag.moved = false
		drag.startPos = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
		drag.startCenter = btn.AbsolutePosition + btn.AbsoluteSize * 0.5
	end)

	conns[#conns + 1] = UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if not drag.active then return end
		local t = input.UserInputType
		if t ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and t ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
		local p = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
		local delta = p - drag.startPos
		if delta.Magnitude > 4 then
			drag.moved = true
		end
		if drag.moved then
			moveTo(drag.startCenter + delta)
		end
	end)

	conns[#conns + 1] = UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if not isPointer(input.UserInputType) then return end
		drag.active = false
	end)

	btn.Activated:Connect(function()
		if drag.moved then
			drag.moved = false
			return
		end
		setPremium(not state.premium)
	end)

	placeButton()
	refreshButton()
end

local function teardown()
	setPremium(false)
	destroyButton()
	state.premium = false
	rawset(ENV, "TTO", nil)
	say("torn down")
end

local function main()
	local prev = rawget(ENV, "TTO")
	if prev and type(prev.teardown) == "function" then
		pcall(prev.teardown)
	end

	M.Passes = mod("Passes")
	M.Tools = mod("Tools")
	M.Products = mod("Products")

	buildButton()
	setPremium(true)

	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if cam then
		cam:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(function()
			placeButton()
		end)
	end

	ENV.TTO = {
		state = state,
		modules = M,
		premium = setPremium,
		toggle = function()
			return setPremium(not state.premium)
		end,
		move = moveTo,
		teardown = teardown,
	}
	say("ready")
end

task.spawn(main)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

		dragging, ds, sp = true, i.Position, frame.Position
		i.Changed:Connect(function() if i.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then dragging = false end end)
	end
end)
UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
	if dragging and (i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement) then
		local d = i.Position - ds

end)

local function getChar()
	local c = player.Character
	return c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"), c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

local state = {spin = false, orbit = false, fly = false}
local flySpeed, orbitCenter, angle = 60, nil, 0
local bv, bg

local function stopFly()
	if bv then bv:Destroy() bv = nil end
	if bg then bg:Destroy() bg = nil end
	local hum = getChar()
	if hum then hum.PlatformStand = false end
end
local function startFly()
	local hum, hrp = getChar()
	if not hum then return end
	hum.PlatformStand = true
	bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity", hrp)
	bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e9, 1e9, 1e9)
	bg = Instance.new("BodyGyro", hrp)
	bg.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(1e9, 1e9, 1e9)
	bg.P = 9e4
end

local hue = 0
RS.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
	hue = (hue + dt * 0.2) % 1
	stroke.Color = Color3.fromHSV(hue, 1, 1)
	local hum, hrp = getChar()
	if not hrp then return end
	if state.fly and bv then
		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
		local look = Vector3.new(cam.CFrame.LookVector.X, 0, cam.CFrame.LookVector.Z).Unit
		local right = Vector3.new(cam.CFrame.RightVector.X, 0, cam.CFrame.RightVector.Z).Unit
		local d = hum.MoveDirection
		bv.Velocity = (cam.CFrame.LookVector * d:Dot(look) + cam.CFrame.RightVector * d:Dot(right)) * flySpeed
		bg.CFrame = cam.CFrame
	end
	if state.orbit and orbitCenter then
		angle += dt * 2
		local pos = orbitCenter + Vector3.new(math.cos(angle) * 12, 0, math.sin(angle) * 12)
		hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos) * CFrame.Angles(0, -angle, 0)
		hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
	elseif state.spin and not state.fly then
		hrp.CFrame = hrp.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(30), 0)
	end
end)

		state[key] = not state[key]
		b.BackgroundColor3 = state[key] and ON or OFF
		if cb then cb(state[key]) end
	end)
end

toggle("Toupie", "spin")

	local _, hrp = getChar()
	orbitCenter = on and hrp and hrp.Position or nil
end)

sp2.TextSize = 13
sp2.Parent = list
Instance.new("UICorner", sp2)
sp2.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	flySpeed = flySpeed >= 200 and 30 or flySpeed + 30
	sp2.Text = "Vitesse vol : " .. flySpeed
end)

closeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	state.spin, state.orbit, state.fly = false, false, false
	stopFly()
	gui:Destroy()
end)
player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function() state.fly = false stopFly() end)

-- Dominator Garage (client-sided, self-building)
-- Tap "CARS" on the left, use the < > arrows to pick a car, press OK to spawn. Then walk up and press Drive.

local VEHICLES = {
	{ name = "Dominator 1", id = 97188597374642, spikes = false, snatch = 110 },
	{ name = "Dominator 2", id = 18705472828,     spikes = true,  snatch = 120 },
	{ name = "Dominator 3", id = 81713342766877,  spikes = true,  snatch = 135 },
	{ name = "TIV 1",       id = 132451995770483, spikes = false, snatch = 150 },
	{ name = "Tornado Shocker", id = 135174872889473, spikes = true,  snatch = 220, drop = 1.6, ride = -2.8 }, -- ride: more negative = sits lower
	{ name = "TIV 2",       id = 76361366591159,  spikes = false, snatch = 150, drop = 1.6, yaw = 90, seat = Vector3.new(-1.5, -1.6, -2) }, -- seat Y lower = sit lower -- if it faces the wrong way use yaw = -90
	-- per-vehicle extras you can add: yaw = 90 (if it drives sideways), seat = Vector3.new(x, y, z)
	-- drop = how far the body lowers to the ground on deploy (for cars with no rig)
}

local MAX_SPEED     = 95
local REVERSE_SPEED = 30
local ACCEL         = 38
local BRAKE         = 70
local DRAG          = 14
local TURN_RATE     = 1.5
local GRAVITY       = 196
local RIDE_OFFSET   = 0      -- negative lowers the car, positive raises it
local DEPLOY_DROP   = 0.8    -- how far the body drops on deploy
local SPIKE_TRAVEL  = 2.5    -- how far spike parts push down into the ground on deploy
local DEFAULT_SEAT  = Vector3.new(-1.5, -0.4, -2) -- lower number = sit lower
local ENGINE_ID     = 136646841190295
local ACCEL_ID      = 71254224253857
local DEPLOY_ID     = 119289479120380
local UNDEPLOY_ID   = 122898196250302
local SPIKE_DEPLOY_ID = 93178620992029 -- deploy sound for cars with spikes

-- tornado snatch (needs the tornado_api_addon.lua block pasted at the bottom of the tornado script)
local SNATCH = {
	Enabled     = true,
	DefaultMph  = 120,       -- wind speed AT THE CAR that snatches it (per car: snatch = N in the list above)
	DeployedMul = 1.5,       -- deployed cars are held down: threshold x this
	Hold        = { 8, 13 }, -- seconds carried in the funnel before being thrown out
	MaxHeight   = 0.55,      -- fraction of the funnel height it gets lifted to
	Lift        = 60,        -- extra upward pull while below max height
	Grip        = 1.6,       -- how hard the wind grabs the car
	ThrowSpeed  = 240,
	ThrowUp     = 140,
	Cooldown    = 25,        -- seconds before it can be snatched again after landing
	MinFieldMph = 90,
}

local function getStorm()
	local g = getgenv and getgenv()
	local f = g and g.TornadoAPI
	if type(f) ~= "function" then return nil end
	local ok, snap = pcall(f)
	return ok and snap or nil
end

local function stormCenterAt(snap, p)
	local h01 = math.clamp((p.Y - snap.pos.Y) / math.max(snap.height, 1), 0, 1)
	local bx, bz = snap.bend(h01)
	return Vector3.new(snap.pos.X + bx, snap.pos.Y, snap.pos.Z + bz)
end

-- wind speed (mph) at a world position, same falloff the tornado probes use
local function localWind(snap, p)
	local c = stormCenterAt(snap, p)
	local d = math.max(math.sqrt((p.X - c.X) ^ 2 + (p.Z - c.Z) ^ 2), 1)
	local Rc = math.max(snap.colR * 0.5, 60)
	return (d < Rc) and snap.peak * (d / Rc) or snap.peak * (Rc / d) ^ 1.1
end

-- wind velocity (studs/s): spin + inflow + updraft
local function windField(snap, p)
	local c = stormCenterAt(snap, p)
	local rx, rz = p.X - c.X, p.Z - c.Z
	local dist = math.max(math.sqrt(rx * rx + rz * rz), 1)
	local rdx, rdz = rx / dist, rz / dist
	local core = math.max(snap.colR * 0.8, 60)
	local vt = (dist < core) and (dist / core) or (core / dist) ^ 0.75
	local h01 = math.clamp((p.Y - c.Y) / math.max(snap.height, 1), 0, 1)
	local upK = math.clamp(1 - dist / (core * 1.7), 0, 1) ^ 0.7
	local peak = math.max(snap.peak, SNATCH.MinFieldMph)
	local v = Vector3.new(-rdz, 0, rdx) * (vt * peak)
		+ Vector3.new(-rdx, 0, -rdz) * (vt * peak * 0.45)
		+ Vector3.new(0, upK * peak * 0.7 * (1 - 0.5 * h01), 0)
	return v, c, dist, core
end

local Players    = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UIS        = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local lp         = Players.LocalPlayer

if getgenv then
	local g = getgenv()
	if g.__Dominator1 then pcall(g.__Dominator1) end
	if g.__DominatorGarage then pcall(g.__DominatorGarage) end
end

local conns, cleanupList = {}, {}
local current, spawning = nil, false

local function cleanup()
	if current then pcall(current.destroy); current = nil end
	for _, c in ipairs(conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
	for _, o in ipairs(cleanupList) do pcall(function() o:Destroy() end) end
	pcall(function() lp.Character:SetAttribute("InVehicle", nil) end)
end
if getgenv then getgenv().__DominatorGarage = cleanup end

-- gui parent
local guiParent
pcall(function() guiParent = gethui and gethui() end)
guiParent = guiParent or lp:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- driving HUD
local hud = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
hud.Name = "DominatorHUD"
hud.ResetOnSpawn = false
hud.Enabled = false
hud.Parent = guiParent
table.insert(cleanupList, hud)

local function mkButton(parent, text, size, pos, color)
	local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
	b.Size = size
	b.Position = pos
	b.BackgroundColor3 = color
	b.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	b.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	b.TextSize = 16
	b.Text = text
	b.Parent = parent
	Instance.new("UICorner", b)
	return b

-- controls
local controls
pcall(function()
	controls = require(lp.PlayerScripts:WaitForChild("PlayerModule", 3)):GetControls()
end)
local function getInput()
	local mv = Vector3.zero
	if controls then
		local o, v = pcall(function() return controls:GetMoveVector() end)
		if o and v then mv = v end
	end
	if mv.Magnitude < 0.05 then
		local x, z = 0, 0
		if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then z -= 1 end
		if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then z += 1 end
		if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then x += 1 end
		if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then x -= 1 end
		mv = Vector3.new(x, 0, z)
	end
	return -mv.Z, mv.X
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- vehicle builder
---------------------------------------------------------------------
local function buildVehicle(def)
	local char = lp.Character
	local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not hrp then error("no character") end

	local result = game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://" .. def.id)
	local model = result and result[1]
	if not model then error("failed to load " .. def.name) end
	if not model:IsA("Model") then
		local wrap = Instance.new("Model")
		model.Parent = wrap
		model = wrap
	end
	model.Name = def.name
	model.PrimaryPart = nil -- WorldPivot is ignored if a PrimaryPart is set

	local yaw = def.yaw or 0
	local seatOffset = def.seat or DEFAULT_SEAT
	local vconns = {}

	-- spike detection (parts named spike / anchor / stake)
	local spikeSet, spikes = {}, {}
	local function spikeNamed(d)
		local x = d
		while x and x ~= model do
			local n = x.Name:lower()
			if n:find("spike") or n:find("anchor") or n:find("stake") then return true end
			x = x.Parent
		end
		return false
	end

	for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("BaseScript") then
			d:Destroy()
		elseif d:IsA("BasePart") then
			d.Anchored = true
			d.Massless = true
			if tonumber(d.Name) then d.Name = "V" .. d.Name end
			if def.spikes and spikeNamed(d) then spikeSet[d] = true end
		elseif d:IsA("Seat") or d:IsA("VehicleSeat") then
			d.Disabled = true
		end
	end

	local names = {}
	for _, c in ipairs(model:GetChildren()) do table.insert(names, c.Name) end
	local spikeCount = 0
	for _ in pairs(spikeSet) do spikeCount += 1 end
	print(def.name .. " parts: " .. table.concat(names, ", ") .. " | spike parts found: " .. spikeCount)

	-- measure visible parts (spike parts excluded) in a given frame
	local function bounds(frame)
		local mn = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
		local mx = Vector3.new(-math.huge, -math.huge, -math.huge)
		local n = 0
		for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
			if d:IsA("BasePart") and d.Transparency < 0.9 and not spikeSet[d] then
				local s = d.Size / 2
				for ix = -1, 1, 2 do
					for iy = -1, 1, 2 do
						for iz = -1, 1, 2 do
							local pt = frame:PointToObjectSpace((d.CFrame * CFrame.new(s.X * ix, s.Y * iy, s.Z * iz)).Position)
							mn = Vector3.new(math.min(mn.X, pt.X), math.min(mn.Y, pt.Y), math.min(mn.Z, pt.Z))
							mx = Vector3.new(math.max(mx.X, pt.X), math.max(mx.Y, pt.Y), math.max(mx.Z, pt.Z))
						end
					end
				end
				n += 1
			end
		end
		return mn, mx, n
	end

	local ref = model:GetPivot()
	local mn, mx, n = bounds(ref)
	if n == 0 then
		spikeSet = {}
		mn, mx, n = bounds(ref)
	end
	if n == 0 then
		local bcf, bsz = model:GetBoundingBox()
		local c = ref:PointToObjectSpace(bcf.Position)
		mn, mx = c - bsz / 2, c + bsz / 2
	end
	local bbSize = mx - mn
	model.WorldPivot = ref * CFrame.new((mn + mx) / 2)
	local halfH = bbSize.Y / 2
	local swap = math.abs(yaw) % 180 == 90
	local width  = swap and bbSize.Z or bbSize.X
	local length = swap and bbSize.X or bbSize.Z

	-- remember where each spike part sits relative to the pivot
	local pivot0 = model:GetPivot()
	for part in pairs(spikeSet) do
		table.insert(spikes, { part = part, rel = pivot0:ToObjectSpace(part.CFrame) })
	end

	local rayParams = RaycastParams.new()
	rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	local function updateFilter()
		rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { model, lp.Character }
	end
	updateFilter()

	-- spawn in front of the player
	local spawnPos = hrp.Position + hrp.CFrame.LookVector * (length / 2 + 12)
	local hit = workspace:Raycast(spawnPos + Vector3.new(0, 100, 0), Vector3.new(0, -300, 0), rayParams)
	local pos = (hit and hit.Position or spawnPos) + Vector3.new(0, halfH, 0)
	local look0 = hrp.CFrame.LookVector
	local heading = math.atan2(-look0.X, -look0.Z)
	local up = Vector3.yAxis
	local speed, vy = 0, 0
	local driving, deployed, deployAlpha = false, false, 0
	local mode = "drive" -- drive / snatched / thrown
	local vel, angVel, airRot = Vector3.zero, Vector3.zero, nil
	local snatchT, snatchDur, snatchCooldown, spinDir = 0, 0, 0, 1
	local snatchMph = def.snatch or SNATCH.DefaultMph
	local deployDrop = def.drop or DEPLOY_DROP

	local function buildCF()
		if airRot then return CFrame.new(pos) * airRot end
		local fwd = CFrame.Angles(0, heading, 0).LookVector
		local look = (fwd - up * fwd:Dot(up)).Unit
		local right = look:Cross(up).Unit
		return CFrame.fromMatrix(pos, right, up, -look)
	end

	local promptPart = Instance.new("Part")
	promptPart.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
	promptPart.Transparency = 1
	promptPart.CanCollide = false
	promptPart.CanQuery = false
	promptPart.Anchored = true
	promptPart.Parent = model

	-- headlights (front of the car)
	local lights, lightsOn = {}, false
	for _, sx in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
		local p = Instance.new("Part")
		p.Size = Vector3.new(0.9, 0.6, 0.3)
		p.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
		p.Color = Color3.fromRGB(70, 70, 70)
		p.Anchored = true
		p.CanCollide = false
		p.CanQuery = false
		p.CanTouch = false
		p.Parent = model
		local sl = Instance.new("SpotLight")
		sl.Face = Enum.NormalId.Front
		sl.Range = 110
		sl.Angle = 55
		sl.Brightness = 5
		sl.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 244, 214)
		sl.Enabled = false
		sl.Parent = p
		table.insert(lights, { part = p, light = sl, x = sx * width * 0.3 })
	end
	local function setLights(on)
		lightsOn = on
		for _, l in ipairs(lights) do
			l.light.Enabled = on
			l.part.Color = on and Color3.fromRGB(255, 244, 214) or Color3.fromRGB(70, 70, 70)
		end
		lightsBtn.Text = on and "LIGHTS: ON" or "LIGHTS: OFF"
		lightsBtn.BackgroundColor3 = on and Color3.fromRGB(200, 170, 40) or Color3.fromRGB(70, 70, 80)
	end

	-- sounds
	local engineSound = Instance.new("Sound")
	engineSound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://" .. ENGINE_ID
	engineSound.Looped = true
	engineSound.Volume = 0.4
	engineSound.RollOffMaxDistance = 200
	engineSound.Parent = promptPart
	local accelSound = Instance.new("Sound")
	accelSound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://" .. ACCEL_ID
	accelSound.Volume = 0.8
	accelSound.RollOffMaxDistance = 200
	accelSound.Parent = promptPart
	local function mkSound(id, vol)
		local snd = Instance.new("Sound")
		snd.SoundId = "rbxassetid://" .. id
		snd.Volume = vol
		snd.RollOffMaxDistance = 200
		snd.Parent = promptPart
		return snd
	end
	local deploySound   = mkSound(DEPLOY_ID, 1)
	local undeploySound = mkSound(UNDEPLOY_ID, 1)
	local spikeDeploySound = mkSound(SPIKE_DEPLOY_ID, 1)
	local engineOn, wasPressing, lastAccel = false, false, 0

	local function place()
		local cf = buildCF()
		local e = deployAlpha * deployAlpha * (3 - 2 * deployAlpha)
		local P = cf * CFrame.new(0, -deployDrop * e, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(yaw), 0)
		model:PivotTo(P)
		for _, sp in ipairs(spikes) do
			sp.part.CFrame = P * sp.rel - cf.UpVector * (SPIKE_TRAVEL * e)
		end
		promptPart.CFrame = cf
		local lcf = cf * CFrame.new(0, -deployDrop * e, 0)
		for _, l in ipairs(lights) do
			l.part.CFrame = lcf * CFrame.new(l.x, -halfH * 0.3, -length / 2 - 0.1)
		end
		return cf
	end

	local cf0 = place()
	do -- calibrate: put the real lowest visible point exactly on the ground
		local cmn, _, cn = bounds(cf0)
		if cn > 0 then
			halfH = -cmn.Y
			pos = (hit and hit.Position or spawnPos) + Vector3.new(0, halfH, 0)
			place()
		end
	end

	print(string.format("%s size: %.1f x %.1f x %.1f | halfH %.2f", def.name, bbSize.X, bbSize.Y, bbSize.Z, halfH))

	local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
	prompt.ActionText = "Drive"
	prompt.ObjectText = def.name
	prompt.HoldDuration = 0
	prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false
	prompt.MaxActivationDistance = math.max(length, width) / 2 + 10
	prompt.KeyboardKeyCode = Enum.KeyCode.E
	prompt.Parent = promptPart

	model.Parent = workspace

	-- enter / exit / deploy
	local function enter()
		if driving then return end
		char = lp.Character
		local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not hum or not hrp then return end
		driving = true
		char:SetAttribute("InVehicle", true)
		updateFilter()
		for _, p in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
			if p:IsA("BasePart") then p.CanCollide = false end
		end
		hum.Sit = true
		hrp.Anchored = true
		prompt.Enabled = false
		deployBtn.Text = deployed and "RETRACT" or "DEPLOY"
		setLights(lightsOn)
		hud.Enabled = true
	end

	local function exit()
		if not driving or mode ~= "drive" then return end
		driving = false
		if char then char:SetAttribute("InVehicle", nil) end
		speed = 0
		local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if hrp and hrp.Parent then
			hrp.Anchored = false
			hrp.CFrame = buildCF() * CFrame.new(-(width / 2 + 4), 1, seatOffset.Z)
		end
		if hum then hum.Sit = false end
		if char then
			for _, p in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
				if p:IsA("BasePart") and p.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then p.CanCollide = true end
			end
		end
		prompt.Enabled = true
		hud.Enabled = false
	end

	local function toggleDeploy()
		if not driving or mode ~= "drive" then return end
		if not deployed and math.abs(speed) > 6 then
			deployBtn.Text = "STOP FIRST"
			task.delay(1, function()
				deployBtn.Text = deployed and "RETRACT" or "DEPLOY"
			end)
			return
		end
		deployed = not deployed
		deployBtn.Text = deployed and "RETRACT" or "DEPLOY"
		if deployed then
			(def.spikes and spikeDeploySound or deploySound):Play()
		else
			undeploySound:Play()
		end
	end

	table.insert(vconns, prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(plr)
		if plr == lp then enter() end
	end))
	table.insert(vconns, lp.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
		driving = false
		prompt.Enabled = true
		hud.Enabled = false
	end))

	-- tornado snatch
	local function startSnatch()
		local cf = buildCF()
		mode = "snatched"
		snatchT = 0
		snatchDur = SNATCH.Hold[1] + math.random() * (SNATCH.Hold[2] - SNATCH.Hold[1])
		vel = cf.LookVector * speed
		airRot = cf.Rotation
		angVel = Vector3.new(math.random() - 0.5, math.random() - 0.5, math.random() - 0.5) * 1.2
		spinDir = (math.random() < 0.5) and 1 or -1
		speed, vy = 0, 0
		deployed = false
		deployBtn.Text = "DEPLOY"
	end

	local function land(g)
		local fwd = airRot.LookVector
		local flat = Vector3.new(fwd.X, 0, fwd.Z)
		if flat.Magnitude < 0.1 then flat = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1) end
		flat = flat.Unit
		heading = math.atan2(-flat.X, -flat.Z)
		airRot = nil
		up = Vector3.yAxis
		pos = g.Position + Vector3.new(0, halfH, 0)
		vel, speed, vy = Vector3.zero, 0, 0
		mode = "drive"
		snatchCooldown = os.clock() + SNATCH.Cooldown
	end

	local function stepAir(dt, snap)
		deployAlpha = math.max(deployAlpha - dt / 0.6, 0)
		if mode == "snatched" then
			snatchT += dt
			if not snap or snap.contact < 0.15 then
				mode = "thrown"
			else
				local field, c = windField(snap, pos)
				local h = pos.Y - snap.pos.Y
				local lift = (h < snap.height * SNATCH.MaxHeight) and SNATCH.Lift or 0
				vel += ((field + Vector3.new(0, lift, 0)) - vel) * math.min(1, SNATCH.Grip * dt)
				local t = snatchT
				local target = Vector3.new(math.sin(t * 1.3 + spinDir) * 1.6, 1.8 * spinDir, math.cos(t * 0.9) * 1.4)
				angVel = angVel:Lerp(target, math.min(1, 1.5 * dt))
				if snatchT >= snatchDur then
					local rx, rz = pos.X - c.X, pos.Z - c.Z
					local d = math.max(math.sqrt(rx * rx + rz * rz), 1)
					local rad = Vector3.new(rx / d, 0, rz / d)
					local tan = Vector3.new(-rad.Z, 0, rad.X)
					vel = rad * SNATCH.ThrowSpeed + tan * (SNATCH.ThrowSpeed * 0.8) + Vector3.new(0, SNATCH.ThrowUp, 0)
					mode = "thrown"
				end
			end
		else
			vel += Vector3.new(0, -GRAVITY, 0) * dt
		end

		pos += vel * dt
		local w = angVel.Magnitude
		if w > 0.0001 then
			airRot = CFrame.fromAxisAngle(angVel.Unit, w * dt) * airRot
		end

		if mode == "thrown" and vel.Y <= 0 then
			local reach = halfH + 3 + (-vel.Y) * dt
			local g = workspace:Raycast(pos + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0), Vector3.new(0, -reach, 0), rayParams)
			if g then land(g) end
		end
	end

	-- main loop
	table.insert(vconns, RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
		dt = math.min(dt, 0.05)

		local snap = SNATCH.Enabled and getStorm() or nil
		local need = snatchMph * (deployed and SNATCH.DeployedMul or 1)
		if snap and snap.contact > 0.05 then
			local mph = localWind(snap, pos)
			if driving then
				windLabel.Visible = true
				windLabel.Text = string.format("WIND %d / %d MPH", math.floor(mph), math.floor(need))
				windLabel.TextColor3 = (mph >= need * 0.8) and Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80) or Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 150)
			end
			if mode == "drive" and snap.contact > 0.4 and os.clock() >= snatchCooldown and mph >= need then
				startSnatch()
			end
		elseif driving then
			windLabel.Visible = false
		end

		if mode ~= "drive" then
			stepAir(dt, snap)
			local final = place()
			if driving and hrp and hrp.Parent then
				hrp.CFrame = final * CFrame.new(seatOffset)
			end
			if engineOn then
				engineSound.PlaybackSpeed = 1.7
				engineSound.Volume = 0.6
			end
			if driving then
				speedLabel.Text = string.format("%d MPH", math.floor(vel.Magnitude * 0.68))
			end
			return
		end

		deployAlpha = math.clamp(deployAlpha + (deployed and 1 or -1) * dt / 1.2, 0, 1)
		if deployed then speed = 0 end

		local throttle, steer = 0, 0
		if driving and not deployed then throttle, steer = getInput() end

		if throttle > 0.05 then
			if speed < 0 then speed += BRAKE * dt else speed += ACCEL * throttle * dt end
			speed = math.min(speed, MAX_SPEED * throttle)
		elseif throttle < -0.05 then
			if speed > 0 then speed -= BRAKE * dt else speed += ACCEL * throttle * dt end
			speed = math.max(speed, -REVERSE_SPEED)
		else
			local d = DRAG * dt
			if math.abs(speed) <= d then speed = 0 else speed -= math.sign(speed) * d end
		end

		-- engine + accelerate sounds
		local pressing = throttle > 0.05
		if pressing and not wasPressing and driving and os.clock() - lastAccel > 1.5 then
			lastAccel = os.clock()
			accelSound:Play()
		end
		wasPressing = pressing
		if driving and not engineOn then
			engineOn = true
			engineSound:Play()
		elseif not driving and engineOn then
			engineOn = false
			engineSound:Stop()
		end
		if engineOn then
			engineSound.PlaybackSpeed = 0.7 + math.clamp(math.abs(speed) / MAX_SPEED, 0, 1) * 1.1
			engineSound.Volume = pressing and 0.6 or 0.35
		end

		local sf = math.clamp(speed / 25, -1, 1)
		heading -= steer * TURN_RATE * sf * dt

		local cf = buildCF()
		local fwd = cf.LookVector
		local flat = Vector3.new(fwd.X, 0, fwd.Z)
		flat = flat.Magnitude > 0 and flat.Unit or fwd
		local dist = speed * dt
		if math.abs(dist) > 0.001 then
			local dir = flat * math.sign(dist)
			local boxCF = cf * CFrame.new(0, halfH * 0.25, 0)
			local bs = Vector3.new(math.max(width * 0.85, 1), math.max(bbSize.Y * 0.4, 1), length * 0.9)
			local ok2, res = pcall(function()
				return workspace:Blockcast(boxCF, bs, dir * (math.abs(dist) + 0.5), rayParams)
			end)
			if ok2 and res and res.Normal.Y < 0.6 then
				speed = -speed * 0.25
			else
				pos += flat * dist
			end
		end

		local g = workspace:Raycast(pos + up * (halfH + 6), -up * (halfH + 60), rayParams)
		if g then
			up = up:Lerp(g.Normal, math.min(1, 10 * dt)).Unit
			local targetPos = g.Position + up * (halfH + RIDE_OFFSET + (def.ride or 0))
			if pos.Y - targetPos.Y > 1.5 then
				vy -= GRAVITY * dt
				pos += Vector3.new(0, vy * dt, 0)
				if pos.Y < targetPos.Y then pos = Vector3.new(pos.X, targetPos.Y, pos.Z); vy = 0 end
			else
				vy = 0
				pos = pos:Lerp(targetPos, math.min(1, 18 * dt))
			end
		else
			up = up:Lerp(Vector3.yAxis, math.min(1, 3 * dt)).Unit
			vy -= GRAVITY * dt
			pos += Vector3.new(0, vy * dt, 0)
		end

		local final = place()

		if driving then
			if hrp and hrp.Parent then
				local e = deployAlpha * deployAlpha * (3 - 2 * deployAlpha)
				hrp.CFrame = final * CFrame.new(seatOffset - Vector3.new(0, deployDrop * e, 0))
			end
			speedLabel.Text = string.format("%d MPH", math.floor(math.abs(speed) * 0.68))
		end
	end))

	current = {
		isDriving = function() return driving end,
		exit = exit,
		toggleDeploy = toggleDeploy,
		toggleLights = function()
			if driving then setLights(not lightsOn) end
		end,
		destroy = function()
			if driving then
				mode = "drive"
				exit()
			end
			for _, c in ipairs(vconns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
			model:Destroy()
			hud.Enabled = false
		end,
	}
end

local function spawnVehicle(def, statusBtn)
	if spawning then return end
	spawning = true
	if current then current.destroy(); current = nil end
	local old = statusBtn and statusBtn.Text
	if statusBtn then statusBtn.Text = "Loading..." end
	local ok, err = pcall(buildVehicle, def)
	if not ok then
		warn("Garage: " .. tostring(err))
		if statusBtn then statusBtn.Text = "Failed" ; task.wait(1) end
	end
	if statusBtn then statusBtn.Text = old end
	spawning = false
end

local panel = Instance.new("Frame")

scripts.code:
--[[
	BABFT - Block Spawner (GUI)

	Credits: TopbarPlus Library by @Member
	Source: https://scriptblox.com/script/Universal-Script-TopBarPlus-Library-233495

	HOW TO USE:
	  1. Open "Options" in the topbar to choose the block and settings.
	     The default block is the one you have the most of in your inventory.
	  2. Press "Place" (topbar or panel), then tap the ground of ANY zone.
	     The zone is detected from the spot you tap.
	  3. The BuildingTool is equipped only AFTER your tap is registered
	     (PICK_DELAY), and unequipped again after spawning.

	NOTES:
	  - Block must exist in ReplicatedStorage.BuildingParts and be in your inventory.
	  - Blocks are placed as a ground grid (no tower), so the gap holds.
	  - The result is counted from your folder under workspace.Blocks,
	    because the InvokeServer return value is nil even on success.
]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local lp = Players.LocalPlayer
local pg = lp:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

-- wait after your tap before the tool is equipped (seconds)
local PICK_DELAY = 0.01

if _G.BabftSpawner then
	local s = _G.BabftSpawner
	for _, ic in ipairs(s.icons or {}) do pcall(function() ic:destroy() end) end
	if s.pickConn then s.pickConn:Disconnect() end
end
if pg:FindFirstChild("BabftSpawnerGui") then pg.BabftSpawnerGui:Destroy() end

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "BabftSpawnerGui"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
gui.Parent = pg

local function corner(parent, r)
	local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
	c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, r)
	c.Parent = parent
end

local function isZone(inst)
	return inst and inst:IsA("BasePart") and string.find(inst.Name, "Zone") ~= nil
end

-- blocks you have in stock, with their amounts
local function stockList()
	local out = {}
	local bp = game.ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("BuildingParts")
	local data = lp:FindFirstChild("Data")
	if not bp or not data then return out end
	for _, m in ipairs(bp:GetChildren()) do
		local s = data:FindFirstChild(m.Name)
		if s and s.Value > 0 and m.PrimaryPart then
			table.insert(out, { name = m.Name, amount = s.Value })
		end
	end
	return out
end

local function ownedBlocks()
	local names = {}
	for _, e in ipairs(stockList()) do table.insert(names, e.name) end
	table.sort(names)
	return names
end

-- default: the block you have the most of
local function defaultBlock()
	local best, bestAmount = nil, -1
	for _, e in ipairs(stockList()) do
		if e.amount > bestAmount then
			best, bestAmount = e.name, e.amount
		end
	end
	return best or "WoodBlock"
end

local cfg = {
	block = defaultBlock(),
	count = "100",
	gap = "0.1",
}

local busy = false
local picking = false

-- ==================== TOOL HANDLING ====================
local function findTool()
	local char = lp.Character
	local inHand = char and char:FindFirstChild("BuildingTool")
	if inHand then return inHand, true end
	local bp = lp:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
	local inBag = bp and bp:FindFirstChild("BuildingTool")
	return inBag, false
end

local function unequipTool()
	local hum = lp.Character and lp.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not hum then return end
	pcall(function() hum:UnequipTools() end)
	local dl = os.clock() + 1.5
	while os.clock() < dl do
		local _, inHand = findTool()
		if not inHand then return end
		task.wait(0.05)
	end
end

local function equipTool()
	local hum = lp.Character and lp.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not hum then return nil, "character not ready" end

	local tool, inHand
	local dl = os.clock() + 2
	repeat
		tool, inHand = findTool()
		if tool then break end
		task.wait(0.05)
	until os.clock() >= dl
	if not tool then return nil, "BuildingTool not found" end

	if not inHand then
		hum:EquipTool(tool)
		local dl2 = os.clock() + 3
		while os.clock() < dl2 and not lp.Character:FindFirstChild("BuildingTool") do
			task.wait(0.05)
		end
	end

	local equipped = lp.Character:FindFirstChild("BuildingTool")
	if not equipped then return nil, "could not equip BuildingTool" end
	return equipped
end

-- ==================== PANEL ====================
local panel = Instance.new("Frame")
panel.Name = "Panel"
panel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
panel.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
panel.Size = UDim2.new(0.88, 0, 0.62, 0)
panel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 24)
panel.BorderSizePixel = 0
panel.Visible = false
panel.Parent = gui
local sl = Instance.new("UISizeConstraint")

sl.MinSize = Vector2.new(260, 280)
sl.Parent = panel
corner(panel, 14)

local pad = Instance.new("UIPadding")
pad.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 14)
pad.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 14)
pad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 14)
pad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 14)
pad.Parent = panel

local list = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
list.Padding = UDim.new(0, 8)
list.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
list.Parent = panel

local function label(parent, text, order, h)
	local l = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	l.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, h or 34)

	l.Text = text

	l.TextScaled = true

end

label(panel, "Block Spawner", 0)

local function row(order, labelText)
	local r = Instance.new("Frame")

	l.TextScaled = true

end

local function textRow(order, labelText, key)
	local r = row(order, labelText)
	local box = Instance.new("TextBox")
	box.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.44, 0)
	box.Size = UDim2.new(0.56, 0, 1, 0)

	box.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)

	box.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
	box.ClearTextOnFocus = false
	box.Parent = r

end

local function dropdownRow(order, labelText, key, getOptions)
	local r = row(order, labelText)

	local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	btn.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.44, 0)
	btn.Size = UDim2.new(0.56, 0, 1, 0)
	btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 42)
	btn.Text = cfg[key] .. " ▾"
	btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	btn.TextScaled = true
	btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	btn.Parent = r
	corner(btn, 8)

	local menu = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
	menu.Position = UDim2.new(0.44, 0, 1, 4)
	menu.Size = UDim2.new(0.56, 0, 0, 0)
	menu.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 34)
	menu.BorderSizePixel = 0
	menu.ScrollBarThickness = 6
	menu.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
	menu.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	menu.Visible = false
	menu.ZIndex = 10
	menu.Parent = r
	corner(menu, 8)

	local ml = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
	ml.Padding = UDim.new(0, 4)
	ml.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
	ml.Parent = menu

	local mp = Instance.new("UIPadding")
	mp.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 4)
	mp.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 4)
	mp.Parent = menu

	local function close() menu.Visible = false end

	local function open()
		for _, child in ipairs(menu:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("TextButton") then child:Destroy() end
		end
		local opts = getOptions()
		if #opts == 0 then
			btn.Text = "none in stock"
			return
		end
		for i, name in ipairs(opts) do
			local o = Instance.new("TextButton")
			o.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 40)
			o.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 55)
			o.Text = name
			o.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
			o.TextScaled = true
			o.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
			o.LayoutOrder = i
			o.ZIndex = 11
			o.Parent = menu
			corner(o, 6)
			o.Activated:Connect(function()
				cfg[key] = name
				btn.Text = name .. " ▾"
				close()
			end)
		end
		menu.Size = UDim2.new(0.56, 0, 0, math.min(#opts, 5) * 44 + 8)
		menu.Visible = true
	end

	btn.Activated:Connect(function()
		if menu.Visible then close() else open() end
	end)
	return close
end

local closeBlockMenu = dropdownRow(1, "Block", "block", ownedBlocks)
textRow(2, "Count", "count")
textRow(3, "Gap", "gap")

local status = label(panel, "tap Place, then tap the ground of any zone", 4, 40)
status.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(160, 160, 170)
status.TextWrapped = true

local function button(text, color, order)
	local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
	b.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 46)
	b.BackgroundColor3 = color
	b.Text = text
	b.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	b.TextScaled = true
	b.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	b.LayoutOrder = order
	b.Parent = panel
	corner(b, 10)
	return b
end

local placeBtn = button("Place", Color3.fromRGB(46, 160, 90), 5)
local closeBtn = button("Close", Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 70), 6)

local banner = Instance.new("Frame")
banner.Name = "PickBanner"
banner.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
banner.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 12)
banner.Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, 56)
banner.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 24)
banner.BorderSizePixel = 0
banner.Visible = false
banner.Parent = gui
local bsl = Instance.new("UISizeConstraint")
bsl.MaxSize = Vector2.new(420, 60)
bsl.Parent = banner
corner(banner, 12)

local bText = Instance.new("TextLabel")

bText.TextScaled = true

bText.Parent = banner

cancelPick.TextScaled = true
cancelPick.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold

corner(cancelPick, 10)

-- ==================== SPAWN ====================
local function spawnAt(c, zone, hitPos)
	local count = tonumber(c.count) or 100
	local gap = tonumber(c.gap) or 0.1
	local name = c.block

	local tool, toolErr = equipTool()
	if not tool then return toolErr end

	local rf = tool:FindFirstChild("RF", true)
	if not rf or not rf:IsA("RemoteFunction") then return "RF missing" end

	local bp2 = game.ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("BuildingParts")
	local model = bp2 and bp2:FindFirstChild(name)
	if not model or not model.PrimaryPart then return "block '" .. name .. "' not found" end

	local data = lp:FindFirstChild("Data")
	local stock = data and data:FindFirstChild(name)
	if not stock then return "no '" .. name .. "' in inventory" end

	local size = model.PrimaryPart.Size
	local stepX = size.X + gap
	local stepZ = size.Z + gap
	local cols = math.ceil(math.sqrt(count))
	local rows = math.ceil(count / cols)
	local offset = stepX / 2

	local base = zone.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(hitPos)
	local half = zone.Size / 2
	local maxX = base.X + (cols - 1) * stepX + offset + size.X / 2
	local maxZ = base.Z + (rows - 1) * stepZ + size.Z / 2
	if math.abs(base.X) > half.X or math.abs(base.Z) > half.Z or math.abs(maxX) > half.X or math.abs(maxZ) > half.Z then
		return "grid does not fit in " .. zone.Name .. " from this spot, pick closer to the middle"
	end

	local function countMine()
		local blocks = workspace:FindFirstChild("Blocks")
		local mine = blocks and blocks:FindFirstChild(lp.Name)
		if not mine then return 0 end
		local n = 0
		for _, d in ipairs(mine:GetChildren()) do
			if d.Name == name then n += 1 end
		end
		return n
	end

	local before = countMine()
	local owned = stock.Value
	local toSend = math.min(count, owned)
	if toSend <= 0 then return "no stock of " .. name end

	local done = 0
	for i = 1, toSend do
		local c0 = (i - 1) % cols
		local r0 = math.floor((i - 1) / cols)
		local shift = (r0 % 2 == 1) and offset or 0
		local rel = CFrame.new(base.X + c0 * stepX + shift, half.Y + size.Y / 2 + 0.2, base.Z + r0 * stepZ)
		local world = zone.CFrame * rel
		local args = { name, owned, zone, zone.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(world), false, world, false, false }
		task.spawn(function()
			pcall(function() rf:InvokeServer(table.unpack(args)) end)
			done += 1
		end)
	end
	while done < toSend do task.wait() end
	task.wait(3)
	return string.format("placed %d of %d in %s", countMine() - before, toSend, zone.Name)
end

-- ==================== FLOW ====================
local function setStatus(t) status.Text = t end

local function stopPick()
	picking = false
	banner.Visible = false
end

local function startPick()
	if busy then
		setStatus("already placing...")
		return
	end
	closeBlockMenu()
	unequipTool()
	picking = true
	banner.Visible = true
	bText.Text = "Tap the ground of any zone"
	setStatus("waiting for a spot...")
end

local function runSpawn(zone, hitPos)
	busy = true
	placeBtn.Text = "Placing..."
	setStatus("placing...")
	task.wait(PICK_DELAY)
	local ok, msg = pcall(spawnAt, cfg, zone, hitPos)
	unequipTool()
	setStatus(ok and tostring(msg) or ("error: " .. tostring(msg)))
	placeBtn.Text = "Place"
	busy = false
end

local pickConn = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
	if not picking or processed then return end
	local t = input.UserInputType
	if t ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch and t ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then return end

	local ray = camera:ViewportPointToRay(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
	local rp = RaycastParams.new()
	rp.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	rp.FilterDescendantsInstances = { lp.Character, gui }
	local hit = workspace:Raycast(ray.Origin, ray.Direction * 1000, rp)

	if not hit or not isZone(hit.Instance) then
		setStatus("tap on the ground of a zone")
		return
	end

	local zone = hit.Instance
	stopPick()
	task.spawn(runSpawn, zone, hit.Position)
end)

cancelPick.Activated:Connect(function()
	stopPick()
	setStatus("cancelled")
end)

placeBtn.Activated:Connect(startPick)
closeBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
	panel.Visible = false
	closeBlockMenu()
	if _G.BabftSpawner and _G.BabftSpawner.optIcon then
		pcall(function() _G.BabftSpawner.optIcon:deselect() end)
	end
end)

-- ==================== TOPBAR ====================
-- TopbarPlus Library by @Member
-- https://scriptblox.com/script/Universal-Script-TopBarPlus-Library-233495
local icons = {}
local optIcon
local okLib, Icon = pcall(function()
	local genv = (getgenv and getgenv()) or _G
	genv.TopbarPlusLibrary = nil
	return loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MemberLol/TopBarPlus/refs/heads/main/Library"))()
end)

if okLib and Icon then
	optIcon = Icon.new()
		:setName("BabftOptions")
		:setLabel("Options")
		:setCaption("Block spawner settings")
		:setLeft()
	optIcon.selected:Connect(function() panel.Visible = true end)
	optIcon.deselected:Connect(function()
		panel.Visible = false
		closeBlockMenu()
	end)
	table.insert(icons, optIcon)

	local placeIcon = Icon.new()
		:setName("BabftPlace")
		:setLabel("Place")
		:setCaption("Pick a zone spot and spawn")
		:oneClick()
		:setLeft()
	placeIcon.selected:Connect(startPick)
	table.insert(icons, placeIcon)
else
	warn("[Spawner] TopbarPlus failed to load, use the panel only")
	panel.Visible = true
end

_G.BabftSpawner = { icons = icons, optIcon = optIcon, gui = gui, pickConn = pickConn }
print("[Spawner] ready | default block: " .. cfg.block .. " | PICK_DELAY=" .. PICK_DELAY)

local function connect(signal, fn)
	local conn = signal:Connect(fn)
	table.insert(connections, conn)
	return conn
end

local function getState()
	return ClientState.get()
end

local function getRoot()
	local char = LocalPlayer.Character
	return char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

local function findMachine()
	local lobby = workspace:FindFirstChild("Lobby")
	if not lobby then return nil end
	local gym = lobby:FindFirstChild("Gym")
	if not gym then return nil end
	local barbells = gym:FindFirstChild("Barbells")
	if not barbells then return nil end

	local root = getRoot()
	local best, bestDist = nil, math.huge

	for _, b in ipairs(barbells:GetChildren()) do
		local boost = b:GetAttribute("Boost")
		local occupant = b:GetAttribute("Occupant")
		local prompt = b:FindFirstChild("TrainPrompt", true)

		local matchesMode
		if equipmentMode == "1.5x" then
			matchesMode = boost and boost >= 1.5
		else
			matchesMode = not boost or boost < 1.5
		end

		if matchesMode and prompt
			and (occupant == 0 or occupant == LocalPlayer.UserId) then
			local part = b:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
			if part and root then
				local dist = (root.Position - part.Position).Magnitude
				if dist < bestDist then
					bestDist = dist
					best = {model = b, prompt = prompt, part = part}
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return best
end

local function startTraining()
	if isStartingTraining then return false end
	isStartingTraining = true

	local machine = findMachine()
	if not machine then
		statusText = "No available " .. equipmentMode .. " machine"
		isStartingTraining = false
		return false
	end

	local root = getRoot()
	if not root then
		statusText = "Waiting for character..."
		isStartingTraining = false
		return false
	end

	statusText = "Moving to " .. machine.model.Name .. "..."
	root.CFrame = CFrame.new(machine.part.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
	task.wait(0.5)

	fireproximityprompt(machine.prompt)
	task.wait(1)

	local training = LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("Training")
	isStartingTraining = false

	if training and training ~= "" then
		statusText = "Training at " .. machine.model.Name
		return true
	else
		statusText = "Failed to start — retrying"
		return false
	end
end

local function skipRebirthCutscene()
	local controllers = LocalPlayer.PlayerScripts:FindFirstChild("Controllers")
	if not controllers then return end
	local cutscene = controllers:FindFirstChild("RebirthCutscene")
	if not cutscene then return end
	local ok, mod = pcall(require, cutscene)
	if ok and type(mod) == "table" and mod.isPlaying and mod.isPlaying() then
		pcall(mod.stop)
	end
end

local function doRebirth()
	if isRebirthing then return end
	isRebirthing = true
	statusText = "Rebirthing..."

	local beforeRebirth = getState().Rebirth

	local training = LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("Training")
	if training and training ~= "" then
		TrainStopRemote:FireServer()
		task.wait(REBIRTH_STOP_DELAY)
	end

	RebirthRemote:FireServer()
	task.wait(1)
	skipRebirthCutscene()

	if getState().Rebirth <= beforeRebirth then
		statusText = "Moving to shrine..."
		local shrine = workspace:FindFirstChild("Lobby")
		if shrine then shrine = shrine:FindFirstChild("Stations") end
		if shrine then shrine = shrine:FindFirstChild("RebirthShrine") end
		if shrine then
			local root = getRoot()
			local part = shrine:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
			if root and part then
				root.CFrame = CFrame.new(part.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
				task.wait(0.5)
				RebirthRemote:FireServer()
				task.wait(1)
				skipRebirthCutscene()
			end
		end
	end

	task.wait(0.5)
	isRebirthing = false

	if getState().Rebirth > beforeRebirth then
		statusText = "Rebirth done — resuming"
	else
		statusText = "Rebirth failed — will retry"
	end
end

				elseif autoRebirth and state.RebirthReady and (state.Rebirth or 0) < MAX_REBIRTH then
					doRebirth()
				elseif not training or training == "" then
					startTraining()
				else
					local now = os.clock()
					if now - lastRepTime >= REP_INTERVAL then
						TrainRepRemote:FireServer(1)
						lastRepTime = now

					statusText = "Training..."

scripts.code:
local Rayfield = loadstring(game:HttpGet('https://sirius.menu/rayfield'))()

local Window = Rayfield:CreateWindow({
   Name = "🎯 Draw Spells Quick Cast | by opaopaky",
   LoadingTitle = "Loading quick buttons...",
   ConfigurationSaving = { Enabled = false },
   KeySystem = false,
})

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

-- Создаем ScreenGui для хранения плавающих кнопок
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")
local QuickGui = CoreGui:FindFirstChild("DrawSpellsQuickCast") or Instance.new("ScreenGui")
QuickGui.Name = "DrawSpellsQuickCast"
QuickGui.Parent = CoreGui

local activeButtons = {}
local isLocked = false -- Флаг закрепления кнопок

-- Функция каста
local function CastSpellFull(spellName)
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char or not char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return end
    
    local hrp = char.HumanoidRootPart
    local origin = hrp.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
    local direction = hrp.CFrame.LookVector
    local targetPos = origin + (direction * 100)
    local currentCFrame = hrp.CFrame

    pcall(function() ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("DrawModeOpened"):FireServer() end)
    task.wait(0.01)

    pcall(function()
        ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("StrokePoint"):FireServer(-0.01, 0.29, currentCFrame)
    end)
    task.wait(0.01)

    pcall(function() ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("StrokeEnd"):FireServer() end)
    task.wait(0.01)

    pcall(function()
        ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("CastSpell"):FireServer(
            spellName,
            origin,
            direction,
            targetPos,
            targetPos
        )
    end)

    if spellName == "BulletStorm" then
        pcall(function()
            ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("BulletStormShot"):FireServer(origin, direction)
        end)
    end

    pcall(function()
        ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("DrawModeClosed"):FireServer()
        ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("ExitDrawMode"):FireServer()
    end)
end

-- Функция создания перемещаемой (плавающей) кнопки
local function CreateFloatingButton(displayName, spellName)
    if activeButtons[spellName] then return end

    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.Name = spellName .. "QuickBtn"
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 70, 0, 70)
    btn.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -35, 0.4, 0) -- В центре экрана по умолчанию
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 45)
    btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    btn.Text = displayName
    btn.TextSize = 12
    btn.TextWrapped = true
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
    btn.Parent = QuickGui

    -- Скругление углов и обводка
    local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 14)
    corner.Parent = btn

    local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 255)
    stroke.Thickness = 2
    stroke.Parent = btn

    -- Логика перетаскивания (Drag & Drop)
    local dragging = false
    local dragInput, dragStart, startPos

    btn.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) and not isLocked then
            dragging = true
            dragStart = input.Position
            startPos = btn.Position

            input.Changed:Connect(function()
                if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                    dragging = false
                end
            end)
        end
    end)

    btn.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
            dragInput = input
        end
    end)

    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if input == dragInput and dragging then
            local delta = input.Position - dragStart
            btn.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
        end
    end)

    -- Быстрый каст при клике/тапе
    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        CastSpellFull(spellName)
    end)

    activeButtons[spellName] = btn
end

-- Функция удаления плавающей кнопки
local function RemoveFloatingButton(spellName)
    if activeButtons[spellName] then
        activeButtons[spellName]:Destroy()
        activeButtons[spellName] = nil
    end
end

local function AddSpellControls(tab, displayName, spellName)
    tab:CreateSection(displayName)
    
    tab:CreateButton({
        Name = "⚡ Instant Cast from Menu",
        Callback = function() CastSpellFull(spellName) end,
    })

    tab:CreateToggle({
        Name = "📌 Enable Floating Button",
        CurrentValue = false,
        Callback = function(Value)
            if Value then
                CreateFloatingButton(displayName, spellName)
            else
                RemoveFloatingButton(spellName)
            end
        end,
    })
end

if getgenv().RivalsCosmeticsCleanup then
    pcall(getgenv().RivalsCosmeticsCleanup)
end

local rs = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local http = game:GetService("HttpService")
local plr = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer

local lib = require(rs.Modules.CosmeticLibrary)
local replicated = require(rs.Modules.ReplicatedClass)
local vmClass = require(plr.PlayerScripts.Modules.ClientReplicatedClasses.ClientFighter.ClientItem.ClientViewModel)
local viewModels = plr.PlayerScripts.Assets.ViewModels
local classes = plr.PlayerScripts.Modules.ViewModels
local pdc = require(plr:WaitForChild("PlayerScripts").Controllers:WaitForChild("PlayerDataController"))
local equipRemote = rs.Remotes.Data.EquipCosmetic

local folder = "Cryptic Hub"
local file = folder .. "/Rivals Cosmetics.json"
local slots = { Skin = true, Wrap = true, Charm = true, Finisher = true }
local added = {}
local saved = {}
local alive = true
local swaps = {}
local swapping
local moduleCache = {}
local oldNc
local oldGet = replicated.Get
local oldVmGet = rawget(vmClass, "Get")

local function get(key)
    local ok, v = pcall(pdc.CurrentData.Get, pdc.CurrentData, key)
    return ok and v or nil
end

local function flush()
    pcall(function()
        if not isfolder(folder) then
            makefolder(folder)
        end
        writefile(file, http:JSONEncode(saved))
    end)
end

local function find(weapon)
    local list = get("WeaponInventory")
    if not list then return end
    for _, w in pairs(list) do
        if w.Name == weapon then
            return w
        end
    end
end

local inv = get("CosmeticInventory")
for name in pairs(lib.Cosmetics) do
    if inv and inv[name] == nil then
        inv[name] = true
        added[name] = true
    end
end

pcall(function()
    if isfile(file) then
        saved = http:JSONDecode(readfile(file))
    end
end)

for weapon, picks in pairs(saved) do
    local w = find(weapon)
    if w then
        for slot, entry in pairs(picks) do
            if slots[slot] and lib.Cosmetics[entry.Name] then
                w[slot] = entry
            end
        end
    end
end

local function baseOf(name)
    local cosmetic = lib.Cosmetics[name]
    if cosmetic and cosmetic.Type == "Skin" and cosmetic.ItemName then
        return cosmetic.ItemName
    end
    return name
end

local function compatible(skinName, heldName)
    local skinModel = viewModels:FindFirstChild(skinName, true)
    local heldModel = viewModels:FindFirstChild(heldName, true)
    if not skinModel or not heldModel then
        return false
    end
    for _, child in ipairs(heldModel:GetChildren()) do
        if not skinModel:FindFirstChild(child.Name) then
            return false
        end
    end
    return true
end

replicated.Get = function(self, key)
    if alive and slots[key] then
        local data = rawget(self, "Data")
        local picks = data and saved[baseOf(data.Name)]
        local entry = picks and picks[key]
        if entry ~= nil then
            return entry
        end
    end
    return oldGet(self, key)
end

local function moduleOf(name)
    local cached = moduleCache[name]
    if cached == nil then
        local found = classes:FindFirstChild(name, true)
        cached = found and found:IsA("ModuleScript") and found or false
        moduleCache[name] = cached
    end
    return cached or nil
end

local function installSwap(weapon)
    if swaps[weapon] then return end
    local defaultModule = moduleOf(weapon)
    if not defaultModule then return end
    local ok, class = pcall(require, defaultModule)
    if not ok or type(class) ~= "table" or type(rawget(class, "new")) ~= "function" then return end
    local origNew = class.new
    swaps[weapon] = { class = class, origNew = origNew }
    class.new = function(...)
        local picks = alive and saved[weapon]
        local skin = picks and picks.Skin
        local skinModule = skin and moduleOf(skin.Name)
        if skinModule and not swapping and viewModels:FindFirstChild(skin.Name, true)
            and (skinModule.Parent == defaultModule.Parent or skinModule.Parent == defaultModule) then
            local loaded, skinClass = pcall(require, skinModule)
            if loaded and type(skinClass) == "table" and type(skinClass.new) == "function" then
                swapping = { weapon = weapon, skin = skin.Name }
                local built, object = pcall(skinClass.new, ...)
                swapping = nil
                if built then
                    return object
                end
            end
        end
        return origNew(...)
    end
end

for weapon, picks in pairs(saved) do
    if picks.Skin then
        installSwap(weapon)
    end
end

vmClass.Get = function(self, key)
    if alive and key == "Name" then
        local data = rawget(self, "Data")
        if data then
            if swapping and baseOf(data.Name) == swapping.weapon then
                return swapping.skin
            end
            local picks = saved[baseOf(data.Name)]
            local skin = picks and picks.Skin
            if skin and not moduleOf(skin.Name) and compatible(skin.Name, data.Name) then
                return skin.Name
            end
        end
    end
    return (oldVmGet or replicated.Get)(self, key)
end

local function refreshHeld(weapon, slot)
    if slot ~= "Wrap" and slot ~= "Charm" then return end
    for _, obj in ipairs(getgc(true)) do
        if type(obj) == "table" and type(rawget(obj, "Data")) == "table" and rawget(obj, "ClientItem") and rawget(obj, "Model") and baseOf(obj.Data.Name) == weapon then
            local entry = saved[weapon] and saved[weapon][slot]
            obj.Data[slot] = entry
            local signal = obj._value_changed_events and obj._value_changed_events[slot]
            if signal then
                pcall(signal.Fire, signal, entry)
            end
            if slot == "Wrap" and obj._UpdateWrap then
                pcall(obj._UpdateWrap, obj)
            end
        end
    end
end

local function equip(weapon, slot, name, extra)
    local w = find(weapon)
    if not w then return false end
    local entry
    if name then
        entry = { Name = name, Inverted = slot == "Wrap" and extra and extra.IsInverted or nil }
    end
    w[slot] = entry
    saved[weapon] = saved[weapon] or {}
    saved[weapon][slot] = entry
    if slot == "Skin" and entry then
        installSwap(weapon)
    end
    flush()
    refreshHeld(weapon, slot)
    return true
end

oldNc = hookmetamethod(game, "__namecall", newcclosure(function(self, ...)
    if alive and self == equipRemote and not checkcaller() and getnamecallmethod() == "FireServer" then
        local weapon, slot, name, extra = ...
        if slots[slot] and (name == nil or lib.Cosmetics[name]) and equip(weapon, slot, name, extra) then
            return
        end
    end
    return oldNc(self, ...)
end))

getgenv().RivalsCosmeticsCleanup = function()
    alive = false
    replicated.Get = oldGet
    vmClass.Get = oldVmGet
    for _, swap in pairs(swaps) do
        swap.class.new = swap.origNew
    end
    local cur = get("CosmeticInventory")
    if cur then
        for name in pairs(added) do
            cur[name] = nil
        end
    end
    getgenv().RivalsCosmeticsCleanup = nil
end

        return HttpService:JSONDecode(response.Body)
    end)
    
    if not decodeSuccess then
        return "Error: Invalid response format"
    end
    
    if data and data.choices and data.choices[1] and data.choices[1].message and data.choices[1].message.content then
        return data.choices[1].message.content
    end
    
    if data and data.error then
        return "ChatGPT Error: " .. (data.error.message or "Unknown error")
    end
    
    return "Error: Unable to parse ChatGPT response"
end

    if currentAI == "Gemini" then

local function ExtractCodeBlocks(message)
    local parts = {}
    local lastIndex = 1
    
    for codeStart, language, code, codeEnd in message:gmatch("()```([%w]*)\n?(.-)\n?```()") do
        if codeStart > lastIndex then
            local textBefore = message:sub(lastIndex, codeStart - 1)
            if textBefore:gsub("%s+", "") ~= "" then
                table.insert(parts, {type = "text", content = textBefore})
            end
        end
        
        table.insert(parts, {type = "code", content = code, language = language})
        lastIndex = codeEnd
    end
    
    if lastIndex <= #message then
        local textAfter = message:sub(lastIndex)
        if textAfter:gsub("%s+", "") ~= "" then
            table.insert(parts, {type = "text", content = textAfter})
        end
    end
    
    if #parts == 0 then
        table.insert(parts, {type = "text", content = message})
    end
    
    return parts
end


local function DisplayAIResponse(message)
    local parts = ExtractCodeBlocks(message)
    local senderAdded = false
    
    for i, part in ipairs(parts) do
        if part.type == "text" then
            if not senderAdded then
                AddMessage(currentAI, part.content, false)
                senderAdded = true
            else
                AddMessage("", part.content, false)
            end
        elseif part.type == "code" then
            CreateCodeBlock(part.content, part.language)
        end
    end
end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Character = LocalPlayer.Character
local RootPart = Character.HumanoidRootPart

local stages = workspace.stages
local currentstage = LocalPlayer.leaderstats.Stage

local function FindNextPortal()
	for i,v in pairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
		if v.Name == "Stage Teleport" and #v:GetChildren() == 4 then
			local enter = v:FindFirstChild("enter")
			if enter ~= nil then
				return enter
			end
		end
	end
end

local function Touch(Part)
	firetouchinterest(RootPart, Part, 0)
	firetouchinterest(RootPart, Part, 1)
end
while task.wait() do
	local CurrentStage = stages:FindFirstChild(tostring(currentstage.Value))
	local NextStage = stages:FindFirstChild(tostring(currentstage.Value + 1))
	local NextNextStage = stages:FindFirstChild(tostring(currentstage.Value + 1))
	RootPart.CFrame = CurrentStage.CFrame * CFrame.new(0,3,0)
	if NextStage then
		Touch(NextStage)
		--Potential Speed Gain?
		if NextNextStage then
			Touch(NextNextStage)
		end
	else
		local NextPortal = FindNextPortal()
		if NextPortal then
			RootPart.CFrame = NextPortal.CFrame
		else
			RootPart.CFrame = CurrentStage.CFrame
		end
		task.wait(1)
	end
end
for i,v in pairs(workspace.badges:GetChildren()) do
	if v.Name == "Platform" then
		Touch(v)
	end
end

	value.Parent = container

	leftBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 1, -22)
	leftBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(36, 38, 40)
	leftBtn.Text = "◄"
	leftBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(160, 165, 170)
	leftBtn.TextSize = 12
	leftBtn.Font = Enum.Font.Code
	leftBtn.Parent = container
	
	local lCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	lCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 2)
	lCorner.Parent = leftBtn
	
	local rightBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	rightBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 32, 0, 18)
	rightBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -40, 1, -22)
	rightBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(36, 38, 40)
	rightBtn.Text = "►"
	rightBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(160, 165, 170)
	rightBtn.TextSize = 12
	rightBtn.Font = Enum.Font.Code

	local rCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	rCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 2)
	rCorner.Parent = rightBtn
	
	local current = default
	local step = (max - min) / 20
	
	leftBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		current = math.max(min, current - step)
		current = math.floor(current * 100 + 0.5) / 100
		value.Text = tostring(current)
		callback(current)
	end)
	
	rightBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		current = math.min(max, current + step)
		current = math.floor(current * 100 + 0.5) / 100
		value.Text = tostring(current)
		callback(current)
	end)

local function notify(text, duration)
	local notif = Instance.new("Frame")
	notif.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
	notif.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(32, 34, 36)
	notif.BorderSizePixel = 0
	notif.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	notif.ClipsDescendants = true
	notif.Parent = notifications
	
	local nCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	nCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 3)
	nCorner.Parent = notif
	
	local nStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	nStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(85, 90, 95)
	nStroke.Thickness = 1
	nStroke.Transparency = 1
	nStroke.Parent = notif
	
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, 0)
	label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 0)
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Text = text
	label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 205, 210)
	label.TextSize = 11
	label.Font = Enum.Font.Code
	label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	label.TextWrapped = true
	label.TextTransparency = 1
	label.Parent = notif
	
	local textBounds = label.TextBounds.Y + 12
	
	TweenService:Create(notif, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, textBounds),
		BackgroundTransparency = 0
	}):Play()
	
	TweenService:Create(label, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {TextTransparency = 0}):Play()
	TweenService:Create(nStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {Transparency = 0}):Play()
	
	task.delay(duration or 3, function()
		TweenService:Create(notif, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1
		}):Play()
		TweenService:Create(label, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {TextTransparency = 1}):Play()
		TweenService:Create(nStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {Transparency = 1}):Play()
		task.wait(0.25)
		notif:Destroy()
	end)
end

local visible = false
local animating = false

local function toggleGui()
	if animating then return end
	animating = true
	visible = not visible
	
	local targetPos = visible and UDim2.new(1, -290, 0.5, -190) or UDim2.new(1, 300, 0.5, -190)
	
	TweenService:Create(main, TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		Position = targetPos
	}):Play()
	
	task.wait(0.35)
	animating = false
end

hideBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggleGui)

UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gpe)
	if gpe then return end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.P then
		toggleGui()
	end
end)

local processed = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
local originalSounds = {}

local function optimizeGame()
	local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
	Lighting.Technology = Enum.Technology.Compatibility
	Lighting.GlobalShadows = false
	Lighting.ShadowSoftness = 0
	
	local function process(obj)
		if processed[obj] then return end
		processed[obj] = true
		
		if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
			obj.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
			obj.CastShadow = false
		elseif obj:IsA("Sound") then
			originalSounds[obj] = obj.SoundId
			if getgenv().StretchConfig.CustomSoundsEnabled then
				obj.SoundId = getgenv().StretchConfig.PopSoundId
			end
		elseif obj:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
			obj.Texture = getgenv().StretchConfig.DotTexture
			obj.Rate = 5
			obj.Size = NumberSequence.new(0.1)
		end
	end
	
	for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		task.spawn(process, obj)
	end
	
	workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(process)
end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	if not getgenv().StretchConfig.CustomSoundsEnabled then return end
	
	for sound, original in pairs(originalSounds) do
		if sound and sound.Parent then
			sound.SoundId = getgenv().StretchConfig.PopSoundId
		end
	end
end)

local function applyForceField(plr, character)
	if plr.Name ~= getgenv().StretchConfig.ForceFieldUser then return end
	for _, obj in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
		if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
			obj.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField
			obj.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("White")
			obj.CastShadow = false
		end
	end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(plr)
	plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
		task.spawn(applyForceField, plr, char)
	end)
end)

if player.Character then
	task.spawn(applyForceField, player, player.Character)
end

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
	task.spawn(applyForceField, player, char)
end)

local holding = false

UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gpe)
	if gpe or not getgenv().StretchConfig.AutoSprint then return end
	if input.KeyCode == getgenv().StretchConfig.SprintKey then
		VM:SendKeyEvent(true, getgenv().StretchConfig.HoldKey, false, game)
		holding = true
	end
end)

UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if input.KeyCode == getgenv().StretchConfig.SprintKey and holding then
		VM:SendKeyEvent(false, getgenv().StretchConfig.HoldKey, false, game)
		holding = false
	end
end)

local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	if not getgenv().StretchConfig.StretchEnabled then return end
	
	local cfg = getgenv().StretchConfig
	Camera.CFrame = Camera.CFrame * CFrame.new(
		0, 0, 0,
		1, 0, 0,
		0, cfg.Scale, 0,
		0, 0, 1
	)
end)

task.spawn(optimizeGame)
notify("Screen Stretch • Press P", 3)

local function fireproximityprompt(Obj, Amount, Skip)
    if Obj.ClassName == "ProximityPrompt" then 
        Amount = Amount or 1
        local PromptTime = Obj.HoldDuration
        if Skip then 
            Obj.HoldDuration = 0
        end
        for i = 1, Amount do 
            Obj:InputHoldBegin()
            if not Skip then 
                wait(Obj.HoldDuration)
            end
            Obj:InputHoldEnd()
        end
        Obj.HoldDuration = PromptTime
    else 
        error("userdata<ProximityPrompt> expected")
    end
end

local function ProximityPromptCountdown()
   while _G.AutoProximityPrompt do
    wait(_G.ProximityPromptCountdown)
        for i, v in pairs(game:GetService("Workspace"):GetDescendants()) do
            if v:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then 
                fireproximityprompt(v, 1, true)
            end 
        end  -- Espera o tempo definido em _G.ProximityPromptCountdown antes de repetir
    end
end
